newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisie-Leasing on a three mln dnrs bond.
newsitem.headline: Tunisie-Leasing on a three mln dnrs bond.

text.p: Tunisian leasing company Tunisie-Leasing on Thursday said it was launching a three million dinars five-year note issue.
It said coupon rate will be 10.25 percent for notes payable in equal annual tranches, and 11 percent for paper payable at maturity on January 31, 2002.

The rates offered do not reflect a cut by one point of the average money market rate earlier this month and a subsequent similar cut on the Treasury bills market where five-year paper was bidded at 8.5 percent this week.
Subscription to the new issue will start on December 9 and will be closed by January 31,1997.
The company in October launched a similar issue for an amount of seven million dinars at the same rates.
Tunisie-Leasing gross profits during the first half of 1996 amounted to 1.555 million dinars. Net profits for the whole year 1995 was 2.236 million dinars.
Its share was last priced at 46.44 dinars at the Tunis Stock Exchange. ($=0.98 dinar)
